one_line: Mistral unveils cybersecurity model; India releases data‑sharing handbook; AI infrastructure faces pushback and market moves; safety flaws emerge

themes.title: Mistral launches cybersecurity AI model
themes.text: Mistral AI released Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters for cybersecurity, downloadable and runnable independently.

stories.headline: Mistral AI releases Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter model for cybersecurity

themes.title: India issues DEPA data‑sharing handbook
themes.text: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology published a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture, outlining a techno‑legal framework that enables institutions to share data for AI training while retaining control through contracts, clean rooms, and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: AI data‑center expansion meets pushback
themes.text: State lawmakers in Arizona are opposing new AI data‑center projects due to water depletion concerns, while CapGrid raised ₹50 cr to enter the data‑centre market and Core 4 Solutions listed a decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million, reflecting heightened activity in AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona
CapGrid raises ₹50 cr funding, valued at ₹430 cr to expand into drones and data centres
Core 4 Solutions lists decommissioned Nvidia A100 supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million

themes.title: New AI safety vulnerabilities discovered
themes.text: The Volta‑Autodoxer malware sends victim data to large language models to rank assets, and OpenAI patched a chain of HTML preview sandbox vulnerabilities that could have allowed attackers to hijack ChatGPT accounts, with a $5,000 bug bounty awarded.

stories.headline: Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets
OpenAI patches HTML preview exploit that let attackers hijack ChatGPT accounts
